patterns: Single-fact core: launch year 1920 (APPSC), withdrawal after Chauri Chaura (4 Feb 1922, Gorakhpur), Khilafat aim = protect Ottoman Caliph/territory (APPSC 2023).

APPSC trap statements: 'withdrawn after Jallianwala Bagh' (false); Swaraj Party = C.R. Das + Motilal, not Jawaharlal; Jamia & Kashi Vidyapith are NCM-era but AMU and Besant College, Madanapalle are not (APPSC G1).
Andhra tilt: Andhra Shivaji = Parvataneni Veerayya Chowdary (Pedanandipadu), Chirala-Perala, Palnadu pullari, Vijayawada AICC 1921 and Pingali Venkayya's flag.
Session-president matching (Calcutta special - Lajpat Rai, Nagpur - Vijayaraghavachariar, Gaya - C.R. Das) and chronology sequences are frequent in other PSCs.
App MCQs closely track PYQ facts but add many multi-statement items on Gandhi's trial, Akali and Wahabi movements and Telugu works; more statement-heavy than APPSC's direct items.
